title: MagpieTTS-RT runtime bundle manifest
description: Fail-closed contract for one immutable TensorRT runtime bundle. Runtime code must also enforce the cross-field invariants implemented by the C++ parser.

golden_fixture.description: Self-contained prepared-token startup input authenticated by the accepted golden receipt.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact upstream .nemo source accepted by the referenced receipt. The .nemo bytes are not copied into the runtime bundle.

identity_sha256.description: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no trailing newline over {kind,vocabulary_size,frontend_contract_sha256,vocabulary_sha256,special_tokens}. vocabulary_sha256 uses the ordered Japanese token_table with the same canonical JSON encoding; frontend_contract_sha256 uses the complete frontend_contract object.

identity_receipt.description: Authenticated frontend receipt containing the complete frontend_contract and ordered Japanese token_table from which identity_sha256 is recomputed.

build_receipt.description: Immutable provenance for the exact plugin binary, source hashes, toolchain, deterministic compile flags, and link contract.
